zh-CN.title: 聊天输入与日程优化
items: 小哀语音气泡统一主题配色；Mac 使用 Command＋Enter 换行，Windows 使用 Ctrl＋Enter
日程优先显示当前任务，无今日后续安排时显示今日空闲，浮动日历更紧凑并展示六小时忙闲

en.title: Chat input and calendar refinements
items: Ai voice bubbles match their theme; use Command+Enter on Mac or Ctrl+Enter on Windows for a new line
Calendar summaries prioritize ongoing events and today's availability, with a compact six-hour timeline
